{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Characterizing IT asset/spend expenses — what each expense record is buying (asset type, brand, spend category) and how it flows through the process",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "asset_category", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Directly types the purchased asset, a core facet of what the spend is for."},
    {"name": "asset_brand", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Vendor/brand dimension of the asset, an actionable facet for spend analysis."},
    {"name": "spend_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the nature of the expenditure (hardware vs travel vs cloud), central to the focus."},
    {"name": "travel_flag", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Redundant with spend_type's travel value but still consistent with the spend-classification focus."},
    {"name": "asset_lifecycle_action", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Frames the expense within asset lifecycle, adding a coherent process facet."},
    {"name": "record_origin", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Data-provenance metadata; drifts from the asset/spend focus toward data-quality."},
    {"name": "processing_lag_band", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Processing-time facet that is actionable for operational analysis of expenses."},
    {"name": "has_source_id", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Bare null-presence flag; a generic data-completeness check, not part of the spend focus."},
    {"name": "high_volume_user_flag", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Segments spenders by volume, an actionable analytic angle on expense records."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.72,
  "structure_quality": 0.7,
  "focus_actionability": 0.8,
  "rationale": "The bulk of the columns cohere around a single inferable focus: characterizing what IT-asset expense records are buying (asset_category, asset_brand, spend_type, asset_lifecycle_action) plus operational/segmentation facets (processing_lag_band, high_volume_user_flag, travel_flag). This is a genuine, actionable framing an analyst could pursue for spend optimization. Structure is multi-faceted at a useful granularity rather than a single restatement. It is held back from a top score by mild redundancy (travel_flag duplicates spend_type's travel_expense) and two provenance/completeness columns (record_origin, has_source_id) that read as generic data-quality checks pulling slightly away from the spend focus. Overall a coherent, non-trivial inferred focus with minor scatter."
}
